name: – Andrzej Halicki – § 28 – Am 44
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 28. Underlines that the EU’s security environment has changed dramatically following Russia’s illegal, unprovoked and unjustified war of aggression against Ukraine; recalls the importance of enhancing citizens’ safety and that military and civilian capabilities, external relations and internal security are exclusive competences of the Member States;
